entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help with that. Could I please get your name and order number?
Alex Chen. Order 774-B31. You should be able to find it.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. I want to return it.
I understand. Sometimes a device just isn't the right fit. Before we proceed, I just want to make sure I'm not missing anything. Are you having trouble with a specific feature?

Look, it's just been a mess. My husband's deployment got moved up, then my son had an emergency and was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. I haven't had time to breathe, let alone set up a fitness tracker. I just need to return it.
Oh my, that sounds incredibly stressful. I'm very sorry to hear that and I certainly hope your son is recovering well. Let me check the return eligibility for you immediately.
Okay, Alex, I've just reviewed your order details. I see the delivery was on December 15th.
Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. We can absolutely get this processed for you. No problem at all.
Right. So the whole story about the hospital was unnecessary, then. Good to know.

My apologies, I just have to follow the process and verify the purchase date first. But yes, based on the date, you are fully eligible. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you now.
Fine. When do I get my money back?

As soon as our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued. You can typically expect to see it back on your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after that. The email has all the instructions.
Whatever. Just make sure it works.
It will. Is there anything else I can help with today, Alex?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for you soon.
